question: When is National Javelin Day celebrated in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7th August.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• National Javelin Day is celebrated in India on** 7th August **to honor the sport of javelin throw.
 
• This date commemorates the achievements of Indian javelin throwers,** particularly Neeraj Chopra**, who won a **gold medal at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.**
 
• The day aims to promote javelin throw **as a sport **and inspire young athletes in India.
 
• Various events and activities are organized nationwide** to celebrate and encourage participation** in javelin throw.
 
• It serves as a platform **to recognize the hard work and dedication of athletes** in athletics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72d9ef33274c0f4284ba326e4502ecf51858c34952dc1e00e82d8461230abd4b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **6th August:**

 
 
• This date is significant for the **Tokyo Olympics' closing ceremony**, where Neeraj Chopra was celebrated.
 
• It does not specifically relate to javelin as a dedicated day.
 
 
 
• **12th January:**
 
 
• This day is celebrated as** National Youth Day** in India, marking the birth anniversary of Swami Vivekananda.
 
• It focuses on youth empowerment and leadership rather than any specific sport.
 
 
 
• **29th August:**
 
 
• This date is observed as **National Sports Day in India,** honoring the birthday of hockey legend Dhyan Chand.
 
• It is a broader celebration of all sports rather than focusing specifically on javelin throw
